{{Quote|Darth Soverus made a fine addition to the Dark Council. We should all strive to be as loyal to the end.|[[Darth Arkous]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Darth Soverus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and a member of the [[Tenebrae|Emperor's]] [[Dark Council]].

==Biography==
At some point in his lifetime, he came across the old Sith seer [[Spindrall]], who predicted the circumstances surrounding his death. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3637 BBY]], as the only member of the Council present on the planet, Soverus was killed by a Republic strike team during the [[Korriban Incursion]] as foreseen, fighting to protect the Chambers from defilement.<ref name="TOR" />

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:Soverus battle ready.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Darth Soverus defending the Dark Council chambers]]
Darth Soverus was an expert in lightsaber combat and used the [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] form in his fight against the Republic strike force in the [[Dark Council Chambers|Dark Council chambers]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. He was also capable of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], including guiding a thrown lightsaber and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|Force choking]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Soverus first appeared during the flashpoint ''Korriban Incursion''.<ref name="TOR" />
